jobs.title: Director, AI Strategy and Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Wealth Management Data & AI is responsible for delivering innovative AI capabilities across all of Wealth Management’s global businesses. We are building a high-impact team that will deliver cutting-edge AI solutions for our Digital and Global Investment teams. In this role, you will have the rare opportunity to help shape the future of our business and power innovative offerings fit for the next generation of Wealth Management clients. We’re looking for a critical problem solver to bring strong strategy, business, and product focus to the AI solutions we build. This role exists to ensure our technical team’s strengths and efforts are consistently aimed at the highest-impact problems, land seamlessly in end-user workflows, and create measurable value for the business.

As Director, Strategy and Product Management, you will sit at the intersection of our technical team and our business counterparts. You’ll partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify the right problems to solve with AI, work side-by-side with technical team to translate those problems into well-scoped solutions, and stay close to end-users to ensure out solutions fit their needs and get high adoption. You’ll be the voice of the business inside the technical team, and the voice of the technical team inside the business.

What will you do?

Strategy and Business Leadership

Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify the highest-impact business problems where AI can create outsized value, and surface opportunities that the business may not have considered;
Develop and communicate a clear strategy and roadmap for the team’s AI portfolio, aligned with broader Wealth Management Data & AI priorities
Assess the business case and expected ROI of potential AI solutions, including the financial, operational, client experience, and risk dimensions of impact;
Prioritize the team’s portfolio of initiatives, balancing near-term wins with longer-term, higher-ambition bets, and adjusting priorities as conditions evolve;
Act as the ongoing business owner for the team’s portfolio, liaising with stakeholders across the development lifecycle to ensure alignment, momentum, and business value capture;

Product Management

Develop a deep understanding of end-user workflows, and ensure our solutions integrate into those workflows seamlessly;
Build a working understanding of the business’ technology stack, and guide the technical team on which platforms, systems, and data sources our solutions should integrate with, and how;
Help the technical team translate business requirements into a clear development plan, including scoping, sequencing, and trade-off decisions on functionality, model choice, and delivery approach;
Define business and technical success metrics for each solution, and put in place the measurement mechanisms needed to track performance against them through and beyond deployment;
Champion a test-and-learn approach to AI product development, promoting experimentation, structured pilots, and the use of evidence to drive decisions about scaling, iterating, or sunsetting solutions

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with senior business stakeholders, end-user communities, technology partners, and control functions such as risk, compliance, and legal;
Communicate vision, strategy, progress, and outcomes clearly and credibly to senior leadership, ensuring transparency, alignment, and buy-in;
Represent the business perspective inside the technical team, and the technical team’s perspective inside the business, translating fluently in both directions;
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and industry trends, and translate external developments into practical implications and opportunities

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field – Master's or MBA is a plus;
8+ years of experience in a top-tier technology company, financial service organization, fintech, or consulting firm, ideally with meaningful exposure to AI or machine learning products;
Proven experience as a Senior or above Product Manager, with a track record of successfully shipping products in an enterprise environment that drive business impact and customer satisfaction;
A track record of identifying high-impact business problems and delivering technology solutions that produced measurable business outcomes in a large, complex enterprise;
Strong background in AI technologies and their application in product development, with the ability to translate business needs into clear product and technical requirements, and translate complex technical realities back into business language;
Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and analytical judgment, with experience building business cases, defining success metrics, and using data to drive decisions;
Experience developing and maintaining relationships with senior business and technical stakeholders, including the ability to influence without authority;
Deep user empathy and a track record of designing solutions that fit the workflows of the people who actually use them;
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive-level materials and lead working sessions with senior leaders;
Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Access to a variety of job opportunities across business

jobs.title: Director, AI & Data Science
jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact
is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!

Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.

Find out more at artefact.com.

What You Will Be Doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has a substantial Data Science and machine learning background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering (context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and fine-tuning) and in classical machine learning modeling, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on command of core machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.), agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), and fine-tuning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Experience building fine-tuning pipelines end to end: training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
Solid grasp of AI system design: ML model lifecycle (MLOps), agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and observability.
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Preferred

Google Gemini Enterprise ecosystem (Vertex AI, Agent Builder) as the primary stack; basic knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock

Why Join Us

We are united by our values
and strengthened by our hybrid expertise
.

There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

Description

Full-Time

Important Location Requirement:

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located in the same country, city, or region where the job is posted. The successful candidate must be available to attend a local office, meeting, training session, or company event if requested.

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

Compensation:
C$180,000–C$200,000 base salary
, based on experience, plus a performance-based annual bonus targeted at 15%–20% of base salary

Build Financial Clarity Across a Growing Group of Companies

Rothenbury Group
owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

We are hiring an experienced Vice President of Finance
to strengthen financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, forecasting, controls, documentation, and executive decision support across the group.

This is a senior finance leadership role for someone who can enter a complex, multi-company environment, assess the current state of financial information, identify gaps and risks, establish priorities, and provide management with clear, practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership while coordinating with internal finance staff, accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners.

Our Hiring Process

Please apply with your resume and a brief summary of your senior finance experience.

If your background aligns with the role, you will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours of applying
with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview
.

The interview will help us better understand your finance leadership background, technical capabilities, reporting approach, judgment, and experience working with complex financial information. Selected candidates will then be invited to continue through the next stage of the interview process.

Your Mandate

The Vice President of Finance will be responsible for creating greater visibility, organization, accuracy, and accountability across the group’s financial operations.

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the condition of financial records, reporting processes, controls, and supporting documentation
Identify missing information, unexplained balances, inconsistencies, financial risks, process gaps, and priority action items
Improve cash-flow visibility, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting
Build clear reporting structures that help leadership understand performance, obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions
Strengthen reconciliations, approval processes, internal controls, and finance operating discipline
Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external financial, legal, tax, banking, and advisory partners
Provide practical recommendations that support immediate decisions and long-term financial improvement

Key Responsibilities

Review, organize, analyze, summarize, and reconcile financial and accounting information across multiple companies
Review banking, payroll, tax, ownership, investment, corporate, vendor, client, receivable, payable, budgeting, and forecasting records
Prepare executive summaries, management reports, financial models, dashboards, schedules, trackers, reconciliations, workpapers, and memoranda
Develop clear reporting on cash position, cash-flow requirements, expenses, receivables, payables, budgets, forecasts, and financial risks
Identify incomplete records, unexplained transactions, reporting weaknesses, control concerns, and process failures
Improve finance-related document organization, file structures, naming conventions, supporting records, and document readiness
Strengthen month-end, reconciliation, and management-reporting processes
Support budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modelling, and operational finance planning
Review and improve internal controls, approval workflows, finance policies, and accountability standards
Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners
Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, unresolved questions, risks, recommendations, and required next steps
Support financial clean-up projects, transitions, system changes, special reviews, and other senior finance initiatives
Provide senior leadership with accurate, timely, and decision-ready financial information

Required Experience And Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, corporate finance, or senior financial management
At least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position, such as Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance, or an equivalent role
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field
A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred
Strong experience reviewing complex financial records, reports, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, and supporting documentation
Advanced understanding of financial reporting, cash-flow management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and finance operations
Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, financial models, trackers, memoranda, and management updates
Strong ability to identify financial gaps, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, process issues, and business risks
Experience working with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modelling, reconciliations, reporting, and structured data analysis
Experience using accounting systems and managing information related to banking, payroll, receivables, payables, vendors, clients, budgets, forecasts, and corporate records
Excellent written communication, documentation, and presentation skills
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and attention to detail
Ability to manage evolving priorities and provide clear recommendations with limited supervision

Experience That Will Stand Out

Preference May Be Given To Candidates With

Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions
Real estate accounting or finance experience
Property management accounting experience
Asset management or development accounting experience
Experience working in a founder-led, entrepreneurial, or rapidly growing organization
Experience improving an existing finance function rather than only maintaining established systems
Experience strengthening reporting, financial controls, documentation, systems, or cash-flow visibility during a period of growth or transition
Experience combining strategic finance leadership with hands-on financial review and problem-solving

The Leader Who Will Succeed Here

The right person is highly analytical but also practical.

They can review a large volume of financial information, determine what is reliable, identify what is missing, and separate immediate financial risks from lower-priority clean-up work. They are comfortable working with senior management and can explain complex financial matters clearly and directly.

They do not simply identify problems. They organize the work, establish priorities, recommend solutions, and create the reporting and financial discipline required to support better decisions.

They are equally comfortable reviewing detailed reconciliations, preparing executive reporting, coordinating with external advisors, and advising leadership on financial priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success In This Role Will Mean

Leadership has clearer and more reliable visibility into the financial position of the group
Cash-flow requirements, financial obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions are easier to understand
Financial records and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and decision-ready
Management reporting is timely, accurate, and useful
Reconciliations, controls, approvals, and finance processes operate with greater discipline
Missing information and unresolved financial issues are identified and assigned clear next steps
Accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, and internal teams operate with stronger structure and accountability
The finance function becomes more scalable as Rothenbury Group continues to grow

Compensation and Opportunity

The base salary range for this position is C$180,000–C$200,000
, based on the candidate’s finance leadership experience, professional designation, multi-company background, technical capabilities, industry exposure, and overall fit.

The Successful Candidate Will Also Be Eligible For a Performance-based Annual Bonus Targeted At 15%–20% Of Base Salary. Bonus Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Financial reporting accuracy and timeliness
Cash-flow visibility and forecasting quality
Strength of financial controls
Completion of reconciliations and financial clean-up priorities
Improvement in management reporting
Finance-process discipline
Quality of executive decision support
Progress in building a scalable and accountable finance function

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position with meaningful influence across a diverse and growing group of businesses.

new_jobs.title: Director, AI & Data Science
new_jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact
is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!

Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.

Find out more at artefact.com.

What You Will Be Doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has a substantial Data Science and machine learning background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering (context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and fine-tuning) and in classical machine learning modeling, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on command of core machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.), agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), and fine-tuning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Experience building fine-tuning pipelines end to end: training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
Solid grasp of AI system design: ML model lifecycle (MLOps), agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and observability.
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Preferred

Google Gemini Enterprise ecosystem (Vertex AI, Agent Builder) as the primary stack; basic knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock

Why Join Us

We are united by our values
and strengthened by our hybrid expertise
.

There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.
